body:
Triage (triage seat, hourly round 2026-08-26, session `session_01PVUQHLY6uhGUCs4mD9fzFC`): graded → `pm:blocked`, type Bug, `domain:ui` (fix lands in `content/docs/components/overlay/menubar.mdx`, a published-library docs face). Bug: the page publishes an interface that does not exist and contradicts the shipped `MenuItem` on five of six lines — it is the producer of the fixture defect #6249 repaired, verified still present on `origin/main` (`menubar.mdx:15`). Scope as filed: correct the Schema block to the declared surface (`label` required, `shortcut?: string`, `separator?: boolean`, `children`, drop `value`); the `onSelect` handler line stays excluded (PR #6345 / #6346 own it). The card's open question — whether the page should teach `shortcut` at all when this renderer never reads it — follows #6249's honesty precedent and is additionally an input to the #6523 decision filed alongside; the dev should align with whichever way #6523 is ruled if it lands first, else keep the declared key documented with the renderer caveat.

Blocked-by: #6132

`menubar.mdx` is in open PR #6345's diff (the same-file hold that moved #6347 to blocked this morning). Unblocks when #6132 lands; re-verify the Schema block on the merged ref before dispatch. Note the `value` cleanup face spans 21 catalog items across three fixture families — that half is catalog-fixture work and the dispatching seat should decide fold vs split at claim time.
